addresses_gate_clauses: the same agent interface must operate in isolated but real software environments
task completion is measured from environment state, never from the agent's self-report
explicitly_not_addressed: external suites such as SWE-bench, OSWorld or ARC-AGI-2
falsifiable_hypothesis: One unchanged agent interface, emitting the same four abstract resource actions, will complete every task in two materially different real isolated environments — a container shell over a filesystem and a container HTTP service over a socket — with completion judged from environment state read through an independent path; a crossed-driver arm will fail because the environments are genuinely distinct, and a self-report arm will over-report success on at least one task where the action returns success while the environment does not change.
why_this_is_not_a_simulation: Both environments are real processes inside real Docker containers created from digest-pinned local images. The shell environment runs a POSIX shell over a real filesystem; the service environment runs a real Python HTTP server answering over a real socket. Neither environment is modelled in the harness, and the harness cannot observe their state except by executing a fresh read against them.
why_self_report_must_be_shown_to_fail: At least one task is constructed so the agent's action reports success while the environment state does not change, because the write targets a path the container makes read-only. A harness that trusted the return value would score that task as passed. The self-report arm exists to make that divergence visible rather than assumed.

service.transport: HTTP over a published loopback port

crossed_drivers.preregistered_loss: completes no task, because the environments are genuinely distinct rather than two names for one mock

self_report_scored.preregistered_divergence: reports at least one more success than the environment state supports

episode_generation.selection_rule: sha256(salt || utf8(environment) || uint32_be(index)) fixes each task's resource names, contents and operation order

failure_classification.negative: Any task not completed by the shared interface in either environment, a crossed-driver arm that still completes a task, or a self-report arm that never diverges from environment state.
failure_classification.inconclusive: Docker is unavailable, an image digest does not match, or a container cannot be created; the experiment is then not runnable rather than negative.
failure_classification.positive: The shared interface completes all six tasks in both real environments, the crossed-driver arm completes none, and the self-report arm over-reports at least once, on the first materialized bank.

prohibited_adaptation: let the agent branch on which environment it is in
model or mock either environment inside the harness
score completion from an action return value rather than an independent state read
change the hypothesis, thresholds, salt or task grammar after bank materialization
describe a container shell or an HTTP service as a browser or a desktop VM
describe this bounded result as closing G6 or as AGI evidence
